propositions: The process-local lru_cache on _rendered() causes each xdist worker to independently fill the cache and re-render all 178 corpus bodies (~884 pandoc spawns each), resulting in three redundant fills under -n 3 instead of one serial fill, burning approximately 56s of CPU on re-deriving an identical immutable artifact.

The three test_dc_corpus_passes_two_to_five_are_byte_identical parametrizations each recompute pass-1 render output bit-for-bit identical to what _rendered() already cached, duplicating about half their runtime across each worker.

Replace the process-local lru_cache with a session-scoped digest-keyed artifact on disk shared across xdist workers, sharded per stratum with worker-rotated probe order and atomic mutual exclusion via os.mkdir, with a 150s loser fallback deadline below the 300s timeout guard.
The fixed-point tests must read their pass-1 render from the shared artifact rather than recompute it, while retaining their own pass-2 and pass-3 renders for full coverage.
A SHA-256 digest of corpus JSON files, wiki_render module source, and resolved pandoc executable version ensures stale renders are never served after corpus or renderer edits.

All 178 corpus bodies remain rendered by real pandoc with every existing assertion (cardinality, secret scrub, protected excerpts, tables, HTML comments, determinism, fixed point, coverage ratios, non-vacuity) preserved and verified.
